Clasue 3.2 of PSA provding for ISTS waiver
BUYER-BUYING ENTITY PSA
## ARTICLE 3: SUPPLY OF POWER TO BUYING ENTITY
## 3.1 Obligations of Buying Entity:
1. 1.1 Buying Entity undertakes that it shall: -
3. (a) Ensure off take of the available capacity from the Commercial Operation Date of the Project.
4. (b) Ensure availability of the interconnection facility and evacuation of power from the CTU/STU interface of Buying Entity's state periphery from the Commercial Operation Date of the Project.
5. (c) be responsible for payment of theAndhra Pradeshstate transmission related charges and applicable RLDC/SLDC Charges, limited to the charges applicable to the Contracted Capacity of Buying Entity under this Agreement, as determined by Appropriate Commissionfrom time to time.
6. (d) Make payment of the Monthly Bill/Supplementary Bill by the Due Date.
7. (e) Open and maintain Payment Security Mechanism as per Article 6.4 for the entire Term of the Agreement.
8. (f) Arrange for required consent/NOC from STU/SLDC/concerned agenciesin the State of Andhra Pradesh for availing open access/scheduling of the power, within 30 days of acceptance of such application from the SPD.
9. (g) Obtain necessary approval/adoption of PSA along with tariff, trading margin and contracted capacity.
10. (h) Fulfil all the obligations undertaken by Buying Entity under this Agreement.
12. 2 Charges
14. 2.1.Buying entity shall not be liable for any payments to be made for any ISTS charges, open access, CTU scheduling charges (if any) and any other charges from injection/delivery point to the receiving substation(s) of Buying Entity.
15. 2.2 Buyer shall neither be liable for obtaining the open access nor for any payments to be made for such open access to the concerned STU/CTU by Buying Entity.
16. 2.3 This agreement is based on the waiver of the inter-state transmission charges for the conveyance of power namely Open Access Charges, CTU charges, scheduling charges
Jain J Psydeedr Dr - Kew
